title: PolicyBundle
description: A compiled, hashed and signed policy. Authoring is YAML (spec section 15.1); this is the compiled artifact. Section 15.2 forbids interpreting the YAML per order, so the evaluator reads only what is described here. content_hash covers bundle_id, tenant_id, policy, version and rules, and nothing else: promoting a bundle through the lifecycle must not change its identity.

version.description: There is no unversioned policy (INV-010). Every change is a new version.

rules.description: A policy with no rules enforces nothing, so an empty list is invalid.

id.description: A decision must be able to name the rule that produced it.

action.description: Order-level control actions from section 16. ISOLATE_COHORT and READ_ONLY are fleet-level and cannot be emitted by a per-order rule (INV-009, Phase 13). Resolution across matching rules takes the most restrictive, so rule order in the source does not change the outcome.

needs_notional.description: Computed at compile time. A size-dependent rule fires when order size cannot be determined, so a notional limit is not avoidable by omitting the notional.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical encoding. Recorded on every decision.

signature.description: Ed25519 over content_hash. Required before ACTIVE (INV-010).

activation.description: Staged deployment metadata (spec section 43). Outside content_hash on purpose.

status.description: Forward-only pipeline with rollback available from SIGN onward. ROLLED_BACK is terminal: production policy is never edited in place, a new version is created instead. Only ACTIVE enforces production; SHADOW and CANARY do not.

rollback_reason.description: Required on rollback; one without a reason cannot be explained later.
